feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: France blames Iran for massive cyber attack on supermarket fridges
articles.summary: France has accused Iran of being behind the massive cyber attack on supermarket fridges last month.

articles.title: Explosion at steel plant in Turkey kills 16, president says
articles.summary: A major fire broke out following an explosion at an iron and steel plant in Turkey on Monday killing 16 people, the country's president confirmed.

articles.title: 'Positive momentum' towards end to Iran war, Trump says
articles.summary: There is "positive momentum" towards an end to the Iran war, Donald Trump has said.

articles.title: Joe Biden scales back book tour as he reveals cancer treatment progress
articles.summary: Former US president Joe Biden said he won't be "able to have as many conversations" about his upcoming memoir as he would want to because of his cancer diagnosis.

articles.title: At least 14 dead after boat carrying migrants found near Crete
articles.summary: At least 14 people have died after a boat carrying migrants was found near Crete, Greek authorities have said.

articles.title: AI giant Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with 'Chinese spy'
articles.summary: The chief executive of tech giant Nvidia has admitted having an affair, with the company investigating reports that he was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.

articles.title: Seven dead and 114 injured in train crash near Cairo
articles.summary: At least seven people have died and more than 100 have been left injured in a major train crash south of Cairo, according to the Egyptian Chief Prosecutor’s office.

articles.title: Finland's navy chief says Russia's presence in the Baltic Sea may have peaked for now
articles.summary: Russia may have reached the limit of its "peacetime" ability to project force in the Baltic Sea, with the maritime situation "tense" but "stable", the head of Finland's navy has said.

articles.title: Gunman suspected of killing six people in Polish city of Krakow has died, police say
articles.summary: A gunman suspected of killing six people including a British national in Poland on Saturday has died in hospital.
